name: p1-t01-embedding-qualification
description: DISCOVERY-ONLY qualification harness for P1-T01 / Issue #33 (EmbeddingProvider Qualification Discovery). Not a production package; not a dependency of any production package.
//dependencyJustification: RULES.md §7 requires recording the reason for any new dependency. @xenova/transformers is added here as a DEV-ONLY, DISCOVERY-SCOPED dependency of this isolated harness (own package.json, outside every production package). It is the only in-process, fully-local, version-pinnable runtime available in this environment that can serve a Chinese-capable sentence-embedding ONNX model without corpus egress. It is NOT added to zhihu-answer-grabber/ or corpus-anthology/. If P1-T10 adopts this profile it must promote the dependency to a production package under its own review and record its own justification.
